name: Ridgeline Coffee Roasters
tagline: Small-batch coffee roasted in Portland, Oregon.
description: Ridgeline Coffee Roasters is a specialty roaster in Portland, Oregon. We buy coffee directly from farms and washing stations we visit every year, roast it in small batches on a 15-kilo drum roaster in our Alberta Street roastery, and ship it within 48 hours of roasting. We run cafés in Portland and Seattle, with Austin opening in November.

styles.label: Bright and fruity
styles.description: Light roasts with citrus, stone fruit and florals. Best as pour-over or filter.

styles.label: Classic and chocolatey
styles.description: Medium roasts with cocoa, caramel and nuts. Sweet, balanced, good with or without milk.

styles.label: Espresso forward
styles.description: Developed roasts built for pressure: syrupy body, low acidity, cuts through milk.

styles.label: Easy everyday
styles.description: Forgiving coffees for the daily pot, the cold brew jar and the trail.
